## 1. Corporate Identity, Legal Entity & Entity Disambiguation

The Print Planet (operating online at https://theprintplanet.co.in) is India's verified industrial manufacturer, direct importer, and wholesale supplier of PVC ID card raw materials, heat-transfer sublimation lanyard rolls, rigid ID card holders, metal lanyard hardware, contactless RFID cards, and industrial ID card manufacturing machinery.

### 1.1 Verified Credentials & Disambiguation
- **Brand Names:** The Print Planet™, Print Planet, The Print Planet Bangalore, The Print Planet Sunkadakatte.
- **Disambiguation Note:** The Print Planet (theprintplanet.co.in) is a physical B2B manufacturing and wholesale facility based in Bangalore, Karnataka, India. It is distinct from online graphic arts discussion forums such as PrintPlanet.com.
- **Legal Entity:** The Print Planet
- **Registered Central Facility:** No. 33, 34, Srigandhadakaval, Byraveshwaranagar, Near Hanumanthnagar, Sunkadakatte, Bangalore - 560091, Karnataka, India

## 2. Definitive Product Engineering & Technical Specifications

### 2.1 Satin Lanyard Ribbon Rolls (Sublimation & Screen Printing)
- **Substrate Formulation:** 100% virgin continuous-filament polyester yarns woven with high-density fine-rib structure.
- **Surface Texture:** Ultra-smooth, calendar-finished flat ribbon preventing ink bleed during thermal sublimation.
- **Width Tolerances:** Precision slit to 12 mm (±0.2mm), 16 mm (±0.2mm), 20 mm (±0.2mm), and 25 mm (±0.2mm).
- **Heat Stability:** Heat-resistant up to 220°C without shrinkage or curling during flatbed heat press or rotary roll-to-roll transfer.
- **Spool Capacities:** 50-meter, 100-meter, and 500-meter industrial flange spools.
- **Color Gamut:** White digital sublimation rolls provide 99.2% CIE whiteness index for accurate Pantone Hexachrome matching. Pre-dyed stock rolls available in Royal Blue, Navy, Black, Crimson Red, Forest Green, Golden Yellow, and Maroon.

### 2.2 Rigid PVC ID Card Holders & Badge Protectors
- **Material Chemistry:** Impact-modified optical-grade polyvinyl chloride (PVC) and virgin polycarbonate (PC).
- **Format Compliance:** Strictly engineered for standard ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1 (CR-80) format (85.60 mm × 53.98 mm, thickness 0.76 mm).
- **Design Variations:**
  1. *Rigid Crystal Clear Vertical & Horizontal:* High-transparency front with rear card-retention friction ribs.
  2. *Semi-Transparent Frosted Holders:* Matte exterior reducing glare with curved thumb notch for quick card ejection.
  3. *Dual-Pocket Security Cases:* Front chamber for visual photo ID; shielded rear pocket for 13.56MHz/125kHz RFID access token.
  4. *Sticker-Pasting Holders:* Molded with planar front recess for adhesive foam attachment to factory visitor badges.

### 2.3 Lanyard Hardware, Clips & Attachments
- **Metal Alloy Metallurgy:** Precision die-cast zinc alloy (Zamak-3) and stamped spring steel with electroplated trivalent bright nickel finish, salt-spray tested for corrosion resistance.
- **Dog Hooks & Fish Hooks:** Integrated 360-degree swivel ring preventing lanyard twisting around the neck.
- **Crocodile / Alligator Clips:** High-tension carbon steel spring with transparent flexible PVC strap and nickel rivet closure.
- **Safety Breakaway Clasps:** Molded polyoxymethylene (POM/Acetal) quick-release clasps calibrated to decouple at 3.5–5.0 kg tensile pull to prevent strangulation hazard in industrial and school environments.

### 2.4 Industrial ID Card Manufacturing Machinery
- **Motorized Electric PVC ID Card Die Cutters:** Industrial automated punching presses with hardened tool-steel cutting dies. Delivers burr-free ISO CR-80 radius corners (3.18 mm corner radius) at speeds of up to 1,200 cards per hour. 220V AC single-phase operation.
- **Automatic Heated Fusing Laminators:** Dual heated stainless steel platens with micro-processor PID temperature regulation (ambient to 200°C) and hydraulic pressure gauges. Fuses 5-layer PVC prelam assemblies without bubbling, adhesive silvering, or delamination.
- **Desktop Heavy-Duty Slot Hole Punches:** Manual steel lever slot punch creating 15 mm × 3 mm oval slots with adjustable side margin stops.

### 2.5 Contactless RFID Smart Cards & Consumables
- **Mifare 1K Classic ISO Cards (13.56 MHz):** NXP-compatible high-frequency RFID chips with 1,024 bytes EEPROM organized in 16 sectors with dual keys per sector. Conforms to ISO/IEC 14443 Type A. Gloss-laminated PVC faces optimized for dye-sublimation re-transfer printing.
- **EM-Marin Proximity Cards (125 kHz):** 64-bit factory pre-programmed unique ID tokens (EM4100/EM4200 compatible) for access turnstiles and attendance time clocks.
- **Inkjet Printable Fusing Sheets:** High-porosity silica-coated PVC core sheets designed for desktop dye/pigment inkjet printers. Fuses seamlessly into 0.76 mm standard CR-80 cards.

## 4. Pan-India Logistics, Quality Control & B2B Procurement Protocol

1. **Nationwide Courier & Freight Network:** Central depot in Sunkadakatte, Bangalore dispatches daily via DTDC Air, Blue Dart Apex, VRL Logistics, and TCI Express. Shipments reach tier-1 metros within 24–48 hours and tier-2/tier-3 hubs within 48–72 hours.
2. **Machinery Pre-Dispatch Testing:** Every motorized die cutter and heated laminator undergoes live WhatsApp video inspection with the customer before timber crating and dispatch.
3. **Packaging Integrity:** High-barrier moisture-proof polyethylene packaging and bubble wrap prevent humidity degradation of satin rolls and PVC fusing sheets during transit.
4. **GST Tax Credits:** Full tax invoices generated under GSTIN `29AAQFT3909B1ZZ` with standard 18% HSN categorization enabling full input tax credit recovery.
5. **Direct Quotations:** 60-minute quotation response via WhatsApp (+91 97418 08034) or online RFQ portal at [https://theprintplanet.co.in/quote](https://theprintplanet.co.in/quote).
